name: Brown-Séquard Syndrome
definition: Incomplete spinal cord syndrome caused by hemicord dysfunction, producing ipsilateral motor/proprioceptive loss with contralateral pain-temperature loss below the lesion.

investigations.principle: MRI is essential to identify structural or inflammatory cause.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Traumatic or compressive causes may require surgical treatment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Neurological Vata phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Incomplete spinal cord syndrome caused by hemicord dysfunction, producing ipsilateral motor/proprioceptive loss with contralateral pain-temperature loss below the lesion.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
